title: Server Pack Unpriority
description: Lowers serverpack priority to least prioritized.
body:
# Server Pack Unpriority

## Description

Server Pack Unpriority is a lightweight mod for the 26.1.X series that automatically lowers the priority of the server’s resource pack you’re connected to to the lowest level.

## Project features:

*   Automatic priority adjustment when connecting to a server
*   Plug-and-play installation, no configuration required
*   Full compatibility with version 26.1.X

## How these features improve the user experience:

*   Simplified load-order management: no more manual resource pack tweaks
*   Reduced conflicts: your custom content always overrides the default server pack

## Inspired by Serverpack Priority

> The same as Serverpack Priority by Commander07: [https://github.com/Commander07/Serverpack-Priority](https://github.com/Commander07/Serverpack-Priority) but in version 26.1.X
